scope: linked combined encode/decode cdylib exports, opt-level3/fatLTO/16 codegen units; no timing
limitations: Auto-minus-empty is a matched linked-program delta, not an isolated library object size
M5 size builds use apple-m4 flags; public M5 timings use different compiler-default flags
x86 builds run under Rosetta; tiny wrapper/allocator ABI smoke is not native ISA qualification
Wasm builds here are scalar Wasm codegen, without simd128 or allocation instrumentation
code/read-only/data/BSS are linked storage; runtime heap and retained cache allocations are measured separately
gzip is a deterministic compression-size metric; no gzip artifact is committed
historical benchmark/code-size datasets retain their original source and features

metric_notes.wasm_initial_memory: initial declared linear-memory pages; not live heap allocation
